active_goal: Progress the Lyra AI sandbox through small verified milestones and strengthen Neo into an evidence-driven agent kernel.
focus_area: Lyra AI sandbox plus Neo kernel upgrades

last_verified_run.summary: Audited existing health/death/recovery code and proposed the smallest shared LifeComponent spine for Lyra AI and players.

top_blockers: Neo now has named milestone gate profiles, but each profile still needs more precise thresholds over time.
The active Lyra AI headless gate should focus on metrics/logs and not require visual evidence.
There is no shared health/death/recovery system yet for Lyra AI actors and players.
Lyra AI memory now persists and restores actor summaries, but restored memory does not yet influence behavior.
The lyra_visual gate has generic AI-character visual proof, but Lyra pickup/drop and weapon-alignment captures are still not registered.
Sandbox.tscn Terrain3D spawn placement is not yet live-verified.
Lyra pickup/drop and weapon alignment still need in-editor visual verification.
recommended_next_loop: Implement the first shared life-system slice: add a reusable LifeComponent, wire it to Lyra AI actors and Bachtavious/player damage entrypoints, and prove life_damaged plus downed/death metrics in lyrasandbox.
